record.name: Pinterest
record.one_liner: A visual discovery engine and social media platform for sharing and discovering ideas.
record.access_note: Developers must register a business account and submit an application that is reviewed by Pinterest for trial access.
record.api_note: Covers organic content (Pins and Boards), ad campaigns, targeting, reporting, and shopping catalogs.
record.blocker_note: Applications require review and approval from Pinterest to obtain API access tiers.

evidence.quote: Make sure your API requests on a user"s behalf include a current access token
Application requests are reviewed by Pinterest. You will receive an email notification after your app has been reviewed
Build apps and experiences that allow Pinterest users to create and manage organic content (Pins and Boards)
The Pinterest MCP Server brings Pinterest data into the AI tools you already use
